cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me sort our letters before the van comes. I taught you the keep-and-discard piles; don't leave me doing both for ten years of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've identified who bought the box. Now help with what we both put in it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take it. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose a day we'll open it together. You used to take the whole exercise home and get stuck. I'm not leaving you all the deciding either.

reason: Make A teaching behavior shape the pursuit rather than detach from the relationship, preserving concrete stakes and responsive partner contributions.
